course.title: Office templating with Nutrient
course.subtitle: Authoring templates and generating documents at scale

outcomes.headline: By the end of this session you will be able to

items.label: Author a Word, Excel or PowerPoint template with placeholders.
Model repeating and conditional content in JSON.
Generate documents from a template and a data model.
Export accessible PDF/UA output and verify conformance.

items.title: 1  How templating works
items.objective: The four SDK calls, and why the same code path serves all three formats.

items.title: 2  Authoring your first template
items.objective: Placeholder syntax, and why a marker must sit in a single run.
items.exercise: Add three fields to a letterhead and generate it.

items.title: 3  Repeating and conditional content
items.objective: Sections, inverted sections, and table row loops.
items.exercise: Build a line-item table that grows with the data.

items.title: 4  Accessible PDF output
items.objective: PDF/UA conformance, and what alt text does for generated images.
items.exercise: Export a template to PDF/UA and inspect the tag tree.

items.detail: Optional — output is watermarked without one.
Cloned and building before we start.
